title: The Madman: Five parables
displayOnly: footnote: ¹ Gibran wrote these parables in English, in New York.
footnote: i Ninavah is Nineveh, on the Tigris.
first: Once I said to a scarecrow, “You must be tired of standing in this lonely field.”
And he said, “The joy of scaring is a deep and lasting one, and I never tire of it.”
Said I, after a minute of thought, “It is true; for I too have known that joy.”
Said he, “Only those who are stuffed with straw can know it.”
